li.label: family came to visit
li.description: Family came all this way to see me, with a few things from home. We talked all day about who married whom and whose roof finally fell in.

li.label: helped strangers on the road
li.description: Some merchants were stuck on the road, and I got under the load and got them moving again. I came back black to the elbows.

li.label: settled a quarrel
li.description: Two of our neighbors were ready to come to blows, and I talked them into a split. Neither of them likes it, and both shook on it.

li.label: we helped the neighbors
li.description: Our neighbors had a fever going round and no medicine left, and we sent them some of ours without asking a price.

li.label: buried a stranger properly
li.description: We found an old grave and buried them again in fresh ground, with their things beside them and a stone at the head.

li.label: we robbed a grave
li.description: We dug up a stranger's grave and kept what they were buried with. It doesn't sit right with me.

li.label: an evening of old letters
li.description: We read old letters aloud after supper, two strangers writing to each other for years. I keep wondering how it ended.

li.label: a good fortune
li.description: The fortune teller turned up good cards for me, one after another. I'm not telling anyone what they said.

li.label: a bad fortune
li.description: The fortune teller looked at my last card a long time and put it away without a word. It's only cards.

li.label: the crops are thriving
li.description: Warm nights, soft rain, and the crops are days ahead of where they should be. I could watch them grow.
